title: Algebraic separable extensions are filtered colimits of finite etale algebras
statement:
Let $L/K$ be an algebraic separable extension of fields. Then $L$ is a
filtered colimit of finite separable extensions of $K$; each of those is a
finite etale $K$-algebra, hence a smooth $K$-algebra, so $L$ is a
filtered colimit of smooth $K$-algebras.

proof.text: For every $x\in L$, the field $K(x)$ is finite over $K$ because $L/K$ is algebraic. Given finite subextensions $E_1,E_2\subseteq L$, their compositum $E_1E_2$ is again finite over $K$ and contains both. Thus the finite subextensions form a filtered poset, and their union is $L$, so $L$ is their filtered colimit. Each finite subextension is separable because $L/K$ is separable; by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-etale], its affine scheme over $K$ is etale. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-smooth-zero-dimensional-fibres], an etale morphism in the sense of [def-weil-etale-morphism] is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] (of relative dimension zero), so each stage is a smooth $K$-algebra. The same filtered system consequently exhibits $L$ as a filtered colimit of smooth $K$-algebras.

lean.statement: theorem algebraic_separable_extension_is_filtered_colimit {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] : IsFiltered {E : IntermediateField K L // Module.Finite K E} ∧ (∀ E : {E : IntermediateField K L // Module.Finite K E}, Algebra.IsSeparable K E.1 ∧ Algebra.Etale K E.1 ∧ Algebra.Smooth K E.1) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (finiteSubextensionCocone K L))
lean.note: The finite intermediate-field inclusion diagram and its cocone are canonical helpers for this node. Algebra.IsSeparable includes algebraicity. Finite stages are encoded by Module.Finite in the index; their separability, etaleness, smoothness, filteredness and the K-algebra colimit are all asserted.
